name: One implementation of each Obsmetrological function, composed in Metrologic, with every parallel copy removed
asks: Metrologic is meant to *use* articulating. Every Obsmetrologia function is meant to be a script under Obsmetrologia's services section, and metrologic composes them. [...] remove all parallel implementations of charge, replacing them with this implemnentation, and if consumers expect different behavior, we can deal wtih that later. The same should be true of ALL Obsmetrological functions. [...] We want to REMOVE metrologic's bilattice stuff, emove all parallel implementations of obsmetrological functions, including charge, replacing them with obsmetrologia's own implemnentation, and if consumers expect different behavior, we make them stop doing that and make eveyrthing work the same way. No "composing and adapting". [...] My *ORIGINAL PROMPT* months ago was to import the core functions which work over typed data into metrologic so it provides one clean engine.

x-provenance.recorded-by: Red Cup Engineer Senior (pass obsmetrologia-math of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus)
x-provenance.basis: The Leader's utterances cited below, read in full. The asks field quotes them; the requirements are their EARS rendering and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: Each Obsmetrological function exists once in software, in Metrologic, composed from scripts held at the obsmetrological section, and every parallel implementation and its adapters are gone.

requirements.says: Metrologic shall be the one software implementation of each Obsmetrological function, composing the functions over typed data into one engine.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "My *ORIGINAL PROMPT* months ago was to import the core functions which work over typed data into metrologic so it provides one clean engine." (2026-09-10)

requirements.says: Each Obsmetrologia function shall be held as a script under the obsmetrological services section, and Metrologic shall compose those scripts.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "Every Obsmetrologia function is meant to be a script under Obsmetrologia's services section, and metrologic composes them." (2026-09-10)

requirements.says: Metrologic shall use articulating, and articulating shall depend on nothing but the realization of Obsmetrologia's mathematics; in particular it shall not import Chu-space code.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "Metrologic is meant to *use* articulating." "how does articualting/ need FUCKING CHU ... ITS MEANT TO BE JUST articulating ... from the obsmetrologia math" (2026-09-10)

requirements.says: The house shall hold no implementation of charge, bilattices or any other Obsmetrological function outside Metrologic.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "remove all parallel implementations of charge ... The same should be true of ALL Obsmetrological functions." "bilattices WONT STAY IN FUCKING METROLOGIC WHERE THEY OBVIOUSLY FUCKING GO" (2026-09-10, 2026-09-22)

requirements.says: When a consumer expected behavior that differs from Metrologic's, the consumer shall be changed to Metrologic's behavior, and no adapter, compatibility layer or re-export shim shall be written for it.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "if consumers expect different behavior, we make them stop doing that and make eveyrthing work the same way. No 'composing and adapting'." "Never do a re-export shim" (2026-09-10)

requirements.says: Where two implementations of an Obsmetrological function disagree, the implementation kept shall be the one Obsmetrologia's theory and Lean determine, and none of the variants shall be retained for its own sake.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "dive deeper into the theroy of what ... 'charge' is even meant to be"; "it's like asking 'does 2+2 equal 4 or 7?'"; "I KNOW / I DONT CARE" that the variants differ (2026-09-10, 2026-09-21)

requirements.says: The settling functions, settling() and its kin, shall be owned by one findable section and imported from it by every consumer.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "obsmetrologic-settlement-engineering-services-section needs to own settlign(), etc so that these functions can actually be found." (2026-09-10)

requirements.says: DREW shall be deleted, and the house shall carry no polarity fields on its records.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "DREW gets DELETED. It was never meant to exist"; "I can see you looking at those polarity fields. I actively don't want those" (2026-09-10)

requirements.says: PIK shall be judged against Metrologic and removed if it duplicates Metrologic's logic.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "'PIK' Might not need to exist at all! it sounds like literally just a way for you to have duplicated this logic!" (2026-09-10)

requirements.says: SignCell shall carry no charge algebra of its own and shall import Metrologic for it.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "SignCell shouldn't need charge algebra: metrologic is supposed to use signcraft, so clearly the whole software stack ahas some inversions." (2026-09-25)

requirements.says: SignCell shall be one data object that realizes the house's science of semiotic cells and semiotic foam, superseding every variant called a cellular closure engine, semiotic cell, semiotic foam or closure cell.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "You've managed to avoid writing our most fundamental object/data/class as one ... THOUSANDS of variants of 'cellular closure engine', 'semiotic cell' 'semiotic foam' ... none of that research or specification actually made it into SignCell" (2026-09-25)

requirements.says: SignCell shall hold only what concerns semiotic cells, such as their pores, and every other capability now in it shall move to its owning package.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "a *lot* of hwat is in SignCell is absolutely nothing to do with SignCells, which are about like, Pores and stuff" (2026-09-25)

requirements.says: The mathematics that placeholder glossary terms stood in for shall be served by Metrologic, and the placeholder terms shall be deleted.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "yes delete placeholder terms, metrologic is meant to handle that math now" (2026-09-24)

conditions.says: The specification of one implementation and placement is held.
No module outside Metrologic exports the charge value-algebra.

conflicts: R7: no obsmetrologic-settlement-engineering-services-section exists; the 2026-10-02 SignStuff note seats the settling firing analysis once in Metrologic and the 2026-09-22 seating note gives the descent to SignCraft. One owner is required; which section is open.

R10: the 2026-09-23 software-ecosystem sheet lists SignCraft as requiring Metrologic; the Leader's 2026-09-25 words say Metrologic is supposed to use SignCraft. The direction of that dependency is open.

R2: Metrologic is seated at the computer data section's lib/metrologic as @red-cup-engineering/metrologic; the Leader placed it on 2026-08-26 as @lenticule-science/metrologic, an app under the obsmetrological section next to pymetrologic.
R5: the 2026-10-02 SignStuff note records standing one-line re-exports; they violate R5.
